## Preliminary analysis

I need to compare the different genomes' suitability for mapping.
The genomes are:

* 1BU strain assembly
  * in house and quite fragmented
* AmoebaDB Neff genome
  * quite alright, annotated
* Two good A. castellani genomes published in biorxiv [https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2021.10.26.465878v1.full](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2021.10.26.465878v1.full)
  * strain C3 ATCC 50739, 46.1 MB, [JAJGAO](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/JAJGAO000000000) 
  * strain Neff ATCC 30010, 43.83 MB, [JAJGAP](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/JAJGAP000000000) 
  
  
```{r}
samples <- c("1BU-a", "1BU-b", "1BU-c", "1BU-HCEC-a", "1BU-HCEC-b", "1BU-HCEC-c")
genomes <- c("1BU", "ADB_Neff", "C3", "Neff")
samples_stats <- list()
for (i in samples){
  samples_stats[[i]] <- list()
  fastp_json <- jsonlite::read_json(paste0(res_dir, "LOGS/", i, "_fastp.json"))
  samples_stats[[i]] <- fastp_json$summary$before_filtering[ c("total_reads",
                                                              "read1_mean_length")]
  samples_stats[[i]][["trimmed_reads"]] <- fastp_json$filtering_result$passed_filter_reads
  samples_stats[[i]][["dup_rate"]] <- fastp_json$duplication$rate
  samples_stats[[i]][["insert_peak"]] <-fastp_json$insert_size$peak
  bt2_err <- read_lines(paste0(res_dir, "LOGS/", i, "_filtered_bt2.err.log")) 
  samples_stats[[i]][["total_reads_to_filter"]] <- as.numeric(
    gsub("^\\s*(\\d+)\\s+.*$",
         "\\1", grep("were paired; of these:", bt2_err, value = TRUE)))
  samples_stats[[i]][["reads_retained"]] <- as.numeric(
    gsub("^\\s*(\\d+)\\s.*$",
         "\\1", grep(" aligned concordantly 0 times$", bt2_err, value = TRUE)))
  samples_stats[[i]][["perc_kept"]] <- samples_stats[[i]][["reads_retained"]]/samples_stats[[i]][["total_reads_to_filter"]]
  samples_stats[[i]][["perc_human"]] <- 1 - samples_stats[[i]][["perc_kept"]]
  # star results
  for (j in genomes){
    star_log <- read_lines(paste0(res_dir, "LOGS/", i,"_", j, "Log.final.out"))
    samples_stats[[i]][paste0("uniquemapped_",j)] <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*\\s+([0-9.]+)%$",
         "\\1", grep("Uniquely mapped reads %", star_log, value = TRUE)))
     samples_stats[[i]][paste0("mismatch_",j)] <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*\\s+([0-9.]+)%$",
         "\\1", grep("Mismatch rate per base, %", star_log, value = TRUE)))
     samples_stats[[i]][paste0("multimapped_",j)] <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*\\s+([0-9.]+)%$",
         "\\1", grep("% of reads mapped to multiple loci", star_log, value = TRUE)))
     samples_stats[[i]][paste0("unmapped_",j)] <- sum(as.numeric(
       gsub("^.*\\s+([0-9.]+)%$",
         "\\1", grep("% of reads unmapped", 
                     star_log, value = TRUE))), 
       na.rm = TRUE)
  } 
  samples_stats[[i]] <- unlist(samples_stats[[i]])
}
samples_stats <- do.call("rbind", samples_stats) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var="sample")
```

## Mapping to C3 QC and setup

```{r}
samples <- c("1BU-a", "1BU-b", "1BU-c", "1BU-HCEC-a", "1BU-HCEC-b", "1BU-HCEC-c")
sample_sheet <- data.frame(sample = samples, group = c("ctrl", "ctrl", "ctrl", "HCEC", "HCEC", "HCEC"))
counts <- list() 
genes <- NULL
for( sample in samples){
  readcounts <- read_tsv(paste0(res_dir,"/FeatureCounts/", sample, "_fc_cor.txt"),skip=1) %>% 
    mutate(Chr = unlist(lapply(str_split(Chr, ";"), unique)), 
                        Start = unlist(lapply(str_split(Start, ";"), min)), 
                        End = unlist(lapply(str_split(End, ";"), max)),
                        Strand = unlist(lapply(str_split(Strand, ";"), unique)))
  if (is.null(genes)){
    genes <- readcounts %>% select(Geneid, Chr, Start, End, Strand, Length)
  }
  if (any(readcounts$Geneid != genes$Geneid)) {
    cat("problem with count list of sample", sample)
    break()
  }
  counts[[sample]] <- readcounts[, sample]
}
counts <- do.call(cbind, counts)
rownames(counts) <- genes$Geneid
genes$totalCount <- rowSums(counts)
```

Combine GO Terms from eggnog and C3 Annos

```{r}
gens_bak <- genes
genes <- genes %>% mutate(GO_terms_joined = case_when(is.na(GO_terms) ~ GOs,
                                                      is.na(GOs) ~ GO_terms, 
                                                      T ~ unlist(lapply(paste(GO_terms, GOs, sep=","), 
                                                                 function(x) paste(
                                                                   unique(unlist(str_split(x, ","))), 
                                                                   sep = ",", collapse=",")))
                                                      ))
```


```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
#library(xml2)



get_alt_go_id <- function(goterm){
  requestURL <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/ontology/go/terms/",
                     URLencode(goterm,reserved = TRUE))
  r <- GET(requestURL, accept("application/json"))
  stop_for_status(r)
  httr_res <- httr::content(r)[["results"]][[1]]
  if (httr_res$id != goterm) {
    return(httr_res$id)
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

go_terms <- genes %>% filter(! is.na(GO_terms_joined)) %>% pull(GO_terms_joined) %>% str_split(",") %>% unlist() %>% unique()
go_names <- unlist(lapply(go_terms, 
                          function (x) {
                            y <- AnnotationDbi::Term(x); 
                            if(is.na(y)) { y <- setNames(NA,x)} 
                            return(y)}))

# obsolete terms will be removed
go_update <- sapply(names(go_names[is.na(go_names)]), get_alt_go_id)
obs_go <- names(as.list(GO.db::GOOBSOLETE))
table(names(go_update)[is.na(go_update)] %in% obs_go)
# all NAs are in obsolete, so just get rid of them
for (goterm in names(go_update)){
  if (is.na(go_update[goterm])) {
    genes <- genes %>% mutate(GO_terms_joined = gsub(paste0(goterm,"[,]*"), "", GO_terms_joined))
  } else{
     genes <- genes %>% mutate(GO_terms_joined = gsub(goterm, go_update[goterm], GO_terms_joined, fixed=TRUE))
  }
}
```

ORA:  
* KEGGA can directly use KO as gene ids and use `species.KEGG = "ko"` - does not work if KO are not unique for geneIDs
* goseq custom format:
  * named vector; names geneIDs, values 0,1 for DE
  * vector with length
  * dataframe: geneids, gocategory or list: geneID: vector of goids
* topGO
  * gene-to-GOs: list: geneID: vector of GOids

For GSEA use the $sign(logFC)\sqrt{F}$ for ranking as $F \approx t^2$. Can be z score transformed for better spacing and using the degrees of freedom [https://www.biostars.org/p/9610433/](https://www.biostars.org/p/9610433/)


```{r, eval=TRUE}
library("topGO")
gene2go <- strsplit(res$genes$GO_terms, ",")
names(gene2go) <- res$genes$GeneID
gene2go <- gene2go[ ! is.na(gene2go)]
#res_treat_de <- factor(abs(as.vector(decideTests(res_treat))))
#names(res_treat_de) <- res_treat$genes$GeneID
#GOdata <- new("topGOdata", ontology = "MF", allGenes = res_treat_de, annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = gene2go)
#resultFis <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "classic", statistic = "fisher")
#hist(score(resultFis))
#geneData(resultFis)
#GenTable(GOdata, classic = resultFis, topNodes = 20)

##using gene scores
res_de <- -log10(res_toptags_tab$PValue) * sign(res_tab$logFC)
names(res_de) <- rownames(res_tab)
sig_gene_fun <- function(allScore){ 
  return(10^(-1*abs(allScore)) <= 0.05)
  }
GOdata <- new("topGOdata", ontology = "BP", allGenes = res_de, geneSelectionFun = sig_gene_fun, 
              annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = gene2go, nodeSize = 5)
resultFis <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "classic", statistic = "fisher")
resultWeight01KS <- runTest(GOdata,algorithm="weight01",statistic="ks")
```

Filter similar GO terms. Create table of GENE', 'GO' and 'ONTOLOGY' for GOSemSim godata: 

```{r}
go_table <- lapply(names(go_gmt), function(x) data.frame(GENE = go_gmt[[x]], 
                                                         GO = rep.int(x, length(go_gmt[[x]])),
                                                         ONTOLOGY = rep.int(go_ontology[x], length(go_gmt[[x]]))
                                                         ))
go_table <- bind_rows(go_table)
go_dat_bp <- GOSemSim::godata(annoDb=go_table, ont="BP", computeIC = FALSE)
```


```{r}
bp_sets <- gores_tab[["BP"]] %>% filter(ADJ.PVAL <= 0.05) %>% pull(GENE.SET)
sim_matrix <- GOSemSim::mgoSim(bp_sets, bp_sets, semData = go_dat_bp, measure = "Wang", combine = NULL)


filter_redundant_go <- function(fgsea_res, sim_matrix, similarity_threshold = 0.7) {
  # 1. Filter fgsea results to only valid GO terms present in the semantic data
  # Sort by absolute NES in descending order (highest magnitude first)
  go_terms_loc <- fgsea_res %>%
    filter(GENE.SET %in% rownames(sim_matrix)) %>%
    mutate(abs_nes = abs(NES)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_nes)) %>%
    pull(GENE.SET)
  # 2. Iteratively filter terms based on absolute NES priority
  keep_terms <- c()
  discard_terms <- c()
  for (term in go_terms_loc) {
    if (term %in% discard_terms) next
    # Keep the current term (since it has the highest remaining absolute NES)
    keep_terms <- c(keep_terms, term)
    # Find all other terms highly similar to this one
    similar_idx <- which(sim_matrix[term, ] > similarity_threshold)
    similar_terms <- colnames(sim_matrix)[similar_idx]
    # Mark similar terms to be discarded (excluding itself)
    discard_terms <- unique(c(discard_terms, setdiff(similar_terms, term)))
  }
  # 3. Return the filtered subset of the original fgsea data frame
  filtered_res <- fgsea_res %>%
    filter(GENE.SET %in% keep_terms) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(NES)))
  return(filtered_res)
}
conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)
gores_tab_red <- list()
gores_tab_red[['BP']] <- filter_redundant_go(gores_tab[["BP"]], sim_matrix = sim_matrix)
```

```{r}
# keggrest only retrieves up to 99 entries
kegg_get_chunked <- function(ids, chunk_size = 50) {
  if (! all(str_detect(ids, "^map"))){
    ids <- paste0("map", ids)
    }
  chunks <- split(ids, ceiling(seq_along(ids) / chunk_size))
  map(chunks, KEGGREST::keggList) %>% list_c()
}
KEGG_names <- kegg_get_chunked(KEGG_pwys)
```
